This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.

2. The present Bail Application has been filed by the Petitioner- Nisha Bhasin under Section 528 of the BNSS, 2023 read with Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No.
248/2025 registered at PS Malviya Nagar, Delhi under Sections 420/34 IPC.

The Petitioner has further prayed for setting aside order dated 22.12.2023 passed by the learned ASJ, Saket Courts ,
Delhi (South District) in Bail Application 1553/2025.
3.

The brief background of Petitioner case is that FIR was registered at PS Malviya Nagar on the complaint of Zila Khan alleging that the petitioner, Nisha Bhasin, in conspiracy with her husband,
induced the complainant in September 2023 to invest 15 lakhs on the assurance of 15% monthly returns and doubling of the amount within seven months, citing the husband's senior position in a reputed real estate company to gain trust.
It is alleged that the complainant transferred the said amount in three instalments of Rs.50,000/-,
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/01/2026 at 20:31:40 Rs.9,50,000/- and Rs.5,00,000/- through banking channels between September-October 2023,
after which the accused persons avoided her and failed to return any money, leading to registration of the FIR.
3. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State enters appearance and accepts notice.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the respondent authorities had stationed themselves outside the Petitioner's place and conducted raids on two occasions.

sentences.text:
The Investigating Officer has undertaken that the petitioner shall not be arrested and,
accordingly, the Court has directed that no coercive action in respect of the petitioner's arrest shall be taken till the next date of hearing, i.e., 05 January 2026.
5. As the matter requires consideration and hearing at length, the same is directed to be listed before the Roster Bench on 05th January, 2026.

SHAIL JAIN, J.
(VACATION JUDGE) JANUARY 2, 2026/
